name: absent-attributes
description: Review Focus 1: a clause on an absent or null attribute never matches, notIn and notSegmentMatch included; nested paths (company.plan) with the parent absent, null, a string, a number, an array or an object; paths through arrays and strings (a length segment reads only an object key); an empty context; a rollout whose bucketBy value is absent or unusable (not a string or an integer below 10^15) serves its first variation with a non-zero weight.
